prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Elena, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Elena thinks the municipal pool has been badly maintained for years.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’ve heard the pool water is actually contaminated and completely unsafe for everyone. Please keep your kids far away until we get official confirmation that it isn't toxic!"
text: The pool is officially a toxic hazard zone and the water is rotting from years of neglect. Keep your kids away at all costs because it’s basically a massive health disaster waiting to happen.
